♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 A CHHUAK TA! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, **Your script** leh **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** telh AutoCaptions, leh a hmasain download a, install hmaa rawn zawt che **Flex Studio (Beta)**.

*(I version hman mek chungah install la, After Effects vawi khat restart rawh.)*

♦️ **Thar: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* **Map desk** layout, internet tel lova hmun zawnna, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route leh a dangte), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, a man nei lo map style-te leh **Open in Flex Maps**.
* A hmanrua belhchhahte (live sync, style, label, 3D, Finalize) tunah chuan After Effects chhungah a load tak tak ta.

♦️ **AutoCaptions-a thil thar**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (cloud, Flex AI credit a hmang) hi engine kan rawt ber a ni a, mi zawng zawng tan vawi khat thlan a ni. I computer-ah a man nei lovin caption siam i duh chuan Whisper thlang leh rawh (Translate To hian Whisper a mamawh). Server a buai lai chuan i indawt hmun a lantir ang.
* **Your script**: i thumal sawi hmun apiangah, caption-in i script-a spelling leh thumal hman dan a la ang.
* **Editable template** output: caption-te hi template layer angin a lo chhuak a, Essential Properties-ah a style i thlak thei (After Effects 2026).
* Engmah thlan a nih loh va, Source media a ruak em? **Composition pumpui** a rawn pe ang che. Audio inang chuan a transcript a hmang nawn ang.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** hian a download a, chumi hnuah **Install / Not now** tiin a zawt ang.
* App (2.0.0-beta.2): **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING** workspace-te, After Effects ang tool key-te, clip-te a hawng nghal a, OPEN hi precomp leh adjustment layer-ah pawh a hna a thawk.

♦️ **Siam ṭhat**
* Windows PC tam takah theme effect bo tawhte kha an lo kir leh ta (Windows animation effect tih thih a nih chuan a zang zawk).

♦️ **Licence venhimna atana awmna hmun (i duh chuan)**
* Vawi khat chauh zawh i ni ang a, i duh loh chuan a ngai lo: **No thanks** thlan pawhin engkim a la hna thawk zel. **Flex Settings > Privacy**-ah i thlak thei. Thla 12 chhung dah ṭhat a ni a, hralh ngai lo, dan in a phut loh chuan tumah hnenah pek ngai lo.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 A CHHUAK TA! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack chu AutoCaptions-ah a lut ta**, thumal tin style, layout, motion leh sound nen. **UN-NEST** leh blend mode-te Premiere 26.5-ah a hna a thawk tawh a, **AUTO CUT** hi vawi khat hmeh chauh a ni a, **Flex Studio (Beta)** hian i clip panel atangin a hawng thei.

*(I version hman mek chungah install la, Premiere Pro vawi khat restart rawh.)*

♦️ **Thar: AutoCaptions-a caption che thei**
* **Thumal style**: thumal eng pawh hi amah bik rawng, font leh Flat, Shine emaw Glow finish pe rawh.
* **Tlar layout**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside leh Line.
* **Thumal tin motion** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake leh a dangte) en lawkna nen, **Pop / Tick / Swoosh** sound-te nen. Thumal style leh motion hian **Images** output a mamawh.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (cloud, Flex AI credit a hmang) hi tunah engine kan rawt ber a ni a, mi zawng zawng tan vawi khat thlan a ni; internet tel lova a man nei lovin caption siam i duh chuan Whisper engine thlang rawh.
* **Your script** (Captions mode): i thumal sawi hmunah, caption-in i script-a thumal hman dan a la ang.
* Engmah thlan a nih loh chuan (Source card a ruak), **timeline pumpui** a rawn pe ang che; caption-te chu i project bulah dah ṭhat a ni.

♦️ **Thar: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** hian app-ah clip a track a; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** hian track chu a rawn thawn kir leh. Install a la ni lo em? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** hian a download a, chumi hnuah **Install / Not now** tiin a zawt ang.

♦️ **Thlak danglam**
* **AUTO CUT** hian clip thlan chu a enfiah a, vawi khat hmehin a sat nghal. **Retakes** hian tlar ṭan ṭhatlehte a man chhuak.
* **Audio Studio** hi sub-tab paruk a ni ta. **Library** chu Nest Saver-ah a awm ta.

♦️ **Siam ṭhat**
* Premiere 26.5-a **UN-NEST** (nest zawng zawng a hnawl ṭhin), leh Normal-a lo kir leh ṭhin Screen ang blend mode-te (Premiere English-a hmangtute).
* **AUTOSAVE 0:00** chip sen, Caption Stack preview dum, leh Windows PC tam takah theme effect bo tawhte.

♦️ **Licence venhimna atana awmna hmun (i duh chuan)**
* Vawi khat chauh zawh i ni ang a, i duh loh chuan a ngai lo: **No thanks** thlan pawhin engkim a la hna thawk zel. **Flex Settings > Privacy**-ah i thlak thei. Thla 12 chhung dah ṭhat a ni a, hralh ngai lo, dan in a phut loh chuan tumah hnenah pek ngai lo.
